subject: Legend direction is horizontal (for two legends) if legend position is manually given; a bug?

messages.author: 20a857807016d58a
messages.subject: Legend direction is horizontal (for two legends) if legend position is manually given; a bug?
parts:
Dear expeRts,

The plot below is perfectly fine when the last line ("opts(...)") is
omitted.
The legend is vertically aligned. With the opts(...) and the
legend.position
argument, I just want to move the legend somewhere else. On doing so I
realized
that the legend direction changes from "vertical" to "horizontal". It
remains
horizontal even if legend.direct="vertical" is given. Why? A bug?

Another thing: can the two legends if horizontal be (vertically)
aligned
according to their legend titles at the top? That would also be neat.

Cheers [and sorry for asking so much today],

Marius


library(ggplot2)

df = data.frame(x=rnorm(100), y=rexp(100), group=rep(c("group1",
"group2"), each=50))

ggplot(df, aes(x=x, y=y)) + geom_line(aes(linetype="Linetype")) + #
legend text
scale_linetype_manual(name="Main Group", values=2) + # legend
title and line type
geom_point(aes(colour=group)) + # legend text
scale_colour_manual(name="Sub-group", values=c("green", "blue"),
labels=c("Group 1", "Group 2")) +
opts(legend.position=c(0.8,0.8)) # point colors

parts:
Hi,

Could you please try a new implementation of guides?

here is a instruction for installation,
https://gist.github.com/1150934

and please uncomment the line:
#install_github("ggplot2", "kohske", "feature/new-guides-with-gtable")


example code:

df = data.frame(x=rnorm(100), y=rexp(100),
group=rep(c("group1","group2"), each=50))
lg <- guide_legend(title.position="top", title.hjust=0.5)
ggplot(df, aes(x=x, y=y)) + geom_line(aes(linetype="Linetype")) +

scale_linetype_manual(name="Main Group", values=2) + # legend title
and line type
geom_point(aes(colour=group)) + # legend text
scale_colour_manual(name="Sub-group", values=c("green", "blue"),
labels=c("Group 1", "Group 2")) +

guides(linetype=lg, colour=lg) +
opts(legend.position=c(0.8,0.8), legend.direction="horizontal",
legend.box="vertical") # point colors

example output is attached.

parts:
Dear Kohske,

The code below works, but there are two things:
1) It seems that the space between the legend key and the legend text is smaller than it used to be.
2) Is it possible to left-align the two legends in the box (they seem to be centered with respect to each other)? They were left-aligned before (when they were positioned to the right of the plot).

Cheers,

Marius

# install devtools
install.packages("devtools")

# install dependency of scales package
install.packages(c("RColorBrewer", "stringr", "dichromat", "munsell", "plyr", "colorspace"))

# load devtools
library(devtools)

# move to development mode
# scales and ggplot2 are installed in "~/R-dev" directory, so official version of ggplot2 are not removed.
dev_mode(TRUE)

install_github("scales")

# main branch of development
install_github("ggplot2", "hadley", "develop")
install_github("ggplot2", "kohske", "feature/new-guides-with-gtable")

# load development version of ggplot2
library(ggplot2)
df = data.frame(x=rnorm(100), y=rexp(100), group=rep(c("group1", "group2"), each=50))

lg <- guide_legend(title.position="top", title.hjust=0.5)

ggplot(df, aes(x=x, y=y)) + geom_line(aes(linetype="Linetype")) + # legend text
scale_linetype_manual(name="Main Group foo bar", values=2) + # legend title and line type

geom_point(aes(colour=group)) + # legend text
scale_colour_manual(name="Sub-group", values=c("green", "blue"), labels=c("Group 1", "Group 2")) +
guides(linetype=lg, colour=lg) +
opts(legend.position=c(0.8,0.8), legend.direction="vertical", legend.box="vertical") # point colors

messages.subject: Re: Legend direction is horizontal (for two legends) if legend position is manually given; a bug?
parts:
Dear Kohske,

that's great, thanks! Will that be part of a new version of the package (I
could neither find "legend.box.just" in Hadley's book nor via ?opts)?
That would be great.

Cheers,

Marius

PS: For completeness, I attached the code below. I "faked" a bit more horizontal
space for the label texts for the moment via simple white space.


## install devtools
install.packages("devtools")

## install dependency of scales package
install.packages(c("RColorBrewer", "stringr", "dichromat", "munsell", "plyr", "colorspace"))

## load devtools
library(devtools)

## move to development mode
## scales and ggplot2 are installed in "~/R-dev" directory,
## so the official version of ggplot2 is not removed.
dev_mode(TRUE)

install_github("scales")

## main branch of development

install_github("ggplot2", "hadley", "develop")
install_github("ggplot2", "kohske", "feature/new-guides-with-gtable")

## load development version of ggplot2
library(ggplot2)
df = data.frame(x=rnorm(100), y=rexp(100), group=rep(c("group1", "group2"), each=50))
lg <- guide_legend(title.position="top", title.hjust=0.5)

ggplot(df, aes(x=x, y=y)) + geom_line(aes(linetype=" Linetype")) + # legend text
scale_linetype_manual(name="Main Group foo bar", values=2) + # legend title and line type
geom_point(aes(colour=group)) + # legend text
scale_colour_manual(name="Sub-group", values=c("green", "blue"), labels=c(" Group 1", " Group 2")) +
guides(linetype=lg, colour=lg) +

opts(legend.position=c(0.8,0.8), legend.direction="vertical", legend.box="vertical",
legend.box.just="left") # point colors
